limitations: P1 — Counterevidence: Bolotov's theorem is actually stated to include n4, so no false misquotation claim. BD2010Lemma4.1 is not a verified replacement: Dranishnikov2021Remark1.2 acknowledges its gap. Relevant later RAAG theorem also n>4.

P1 — Counterevidence: Bolotov's printed theorem and proof do include dimension four; the report correctly identifies an invalid supporting proof step rather than a misquoted dimension restriction. The later KO argument detects only the suspended class and does not recover the lost element. The retained Dranishnikov remark acknowledges a different proposed replacement's gap; the later proof read here explicitly requires n>4.
P2 — Counterevidence: Compactness bounds ambient distances, not the intrinsic path distance within a disconnected open star preimage. The complement, not the boundary, has the original retraction.

P2 — Counterevidence: The complement retracts; its boundary need not. A finite family of disconnected open-star inverse images does not have a finite intrinsic-diameter maximum. This does not refute the macroscopic dimension bound.
P3 — Counterevidence: Nonzero pi2Z alone does not force nonzero Euler evaluation.

P3 — Counterevidence: Nonzero pi2(Z) does not imply nonzero Euler evaluation. An implication with impossible antecedent is not logically refuted; the false assertion is that the alternative can occur in this family.
P4 — Counterevidence: Do not confuse Euclidean ambient chord distance with product Riemannian distance.

P4 — Counterevidence: If n>2 were intended, the n=2 literal counterexample would be excluded, but the stated projection still proves only pi*r. Extrinsic chord diameter is not the product Riemannian distance.

proposition.claim:
The null-fiber branch uses a four-dimensional classifying-map compression whose cited proof relies on an invalid relative-to-quotient homotopy identification.

The boundary need not deformation-retract to the complement's spine; a finite list of inverse stars can have infinite intrinsic diameter.

The proposed finite-cyclic fiber-image alternative at m2 cannot occur for the canonical bundles in this torus-divisor construction.

Projection fiber diameter uses extrinsic chord2r instead of intrinsic Riemannian diameterpi*r.

repair.content:
Supply a verified special-bundle compression or direct4-dimensional index/geometric obstruction. Raising the dimension to5 excludes the needed case; a nonequivariant macro-dimension bound alone does not give classifying-map compression.

Use equivariant lift of finite simplicial approximation. Compact translating setsD_E,D_K and proper deck action imply only finitely many gamma with gamma f(D_E) meetingD_K; its preimage lies in finitely many translates ofD_E, hence uniformly bounded fibers. Lipschitzness follows from finite simplicial map.

State infinite-cyclic extension uniformly for this canonical family.

Replace2r bypi*r in projection estimate.
